items.title: Gillian Anderson tells superfans to stop sitting in the front row
items.summary: A TikTok filmed at the stage door of her West End run of Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? caught Gillian Anderson telling a group of fans "You can't come 20 times and sit in the front row, it'll drive me mad." The clip passed 4 million views and set off a debate over theater etiquette and whether she was rude, until she posted that the women were friends of 20 years and asked people to leave them alone.
items.author: @GillianA
